summary_1line: Sarana continues describing to Ravana the vast monkey and bear commanders and their immense forces preparing to attack Lanka.

image_candidates.scene_text: An immense bear king stands like a dark mountain among storm-cloud ranks of bears advancing toward Lanka.
A colossal monkey with a sun-bright tail dragging along the ground marches forward as thousands of monkeys brandish uprooted trees behind him.
Dust rises in yellow clouds as vast troops of roaring monkeys surround their leader while staring toward the distant city of Lanka.
